The '''Crumbling Lands''' was a region on [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]] known for its rocky terrain, sandstone formations and eroded gullies. The sedimentary rock strata of the area had been heavily eroded by [[Water/Legends|water]], and further undermined by the burrowing of the reptilian [[bruwose]]s that inhabited the region.

Six months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Dirk Harkness]] and the [[Black Curs]] landed on Moorja after their reconnaissance of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Harkness ventured alone into the Crumbling Lands to retrieve a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] he had hidden there. While traveling, he was trapped by three bruwoses but was aided by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agents shortly after.
